column1: # anchor dependence: same then-block, but a ';' immediately precedes the CLI name

column5: if true; then :; {S} db push --linked; fi
if [ -f x.sql ]; then {S} db query --project-ref {PROD} -f x.sql; fi
for f in *.sql; do {S} db query --linked -f "$f"; done
while true; do {S} functions deploy send-email; break; done

column1: # subshell form of the cd relocation (trailing ')' must not touch the allowlist match)
# rule 3 disarmed by an unrelated tool's flag in another segment

column5: rsync -v a b; {S} functions deploy send-email
{S} functions deploy send-email --project-ref {DEV} && {S} db query --linked -f x.sql
{S} functions deploy a --project-ref {DEV} && {S} functions deploy b
